paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: Performance of when implemented with base LLMs ranging from 1B to 8B parameters.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the compression factor and accuracy for three different Llama3 models with varying parameter sizes. The x-axis represents the compression factor (c) with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 5, and is labeled with tick marks at intervals of 1. The y-axis represents accuracy as a percentage, also on a linear scale, spanning from 30% to 70% with tick marks at intervals of 10%. Three lines are shown: the brown line, representing Llama3-1B, starts at around 48% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and decreases to approximately 27% at a compression factor of 5; the maroon line, representing Llama3-3B, begins at about 64% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and declines to roughly 40% at a compression factor of 5; the purple line, representing Llama3-8B, starts at approximately 70% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and decreases to around 45% at a compression factor of 5. All three lines exhibit a declining trend as the compression factor increases, with no notable peaks or inflection points.
